questions: Are you currently experiencing a potentially life-threatening problem or feeling that you may be in immediate danger?
Are you having chest pain, pressure, or tightness?
Are you having severe difficulty breathing?
Have you fainted, nearly fainted, or become unusually difficult to wake?
Have you developed sudden weakness or numbness on one side, facial drooping, difficulty speaking, or sudden loss of vision?
Have you had a sudden, severe, or unusually different headache?
Are you experiencing severe or rapidly worsening pain anywhere?
Are you having uncontrolled bleeding, vomiting blood, or passing black or bloody stools?
Are you having severe abdominal pain or persistent vomiting?
Are you having thoughts of harming yourself or someone else?
Is your main concern a physical symptom?
Is your main concern a change in mood, thinking, memory, or behavior?
Did your main problem begin suddenly?
Has your main problem been getting worse?
Have you had fever or chills?
Have you had unexplained weight loss or a significant change in appetite?
Have you had unusual tiredness or weakness?
Have you had a cough, wheezing, or coughing up blood?
Have you noticed racing, irregular, or unusually slow heartbeats?
Have you had swelling of your legs or sudden weight gain?
Have you had nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, or a change in bowel habits?
Have you noticed blood in your urine, pain with urination, or a change in how often you urinate?
Have you had a seizure, new confusion, severe dizziness, or problems with balance?
Have you had new or worsening problems with vision, hearing, speech, swallowing, or movement?
Have you developed a new rash, skin lesion, swelling, or unexplained bruising?
Have you had joint pain, muscle pain, or stiffness?
Could you be pregnant?
Have you recently started, stopped, or changed any medication, supplement, or recreational drug?
Have you recently had an injury, surgery, infection, hospitalization, or significant emotional stress?
Do you have any diagnosed medical conditions or a history of serious illness?
Do you have any medication allergies?
Have close family members had serious illnesses that may be relevant to your concern?
